newsitem.title: UK: BP sells April Brent cargoes to Shell - trade.
newsitem.headline: BP sells April Brent cargoes to Shell - trade.

text.p: British Petroleum sold as many as 11 cargoes of North Sea Brent Blend crude on Thursday to fellow oil major Shell, oil traders said.
The cargoes, due to load in the April 11-21 period, were sold to Shell at differentials to Dated Brent quotes, they said.
Senior BP trading sources declined to comment and Shell traders were not immediately available.
Separately, an April 10-12 Brent cargo moved between traders at May Brent less 93 cents, within this week's trading range.
